Searched the catalog · VolcMiner D1 Mini Pre

No date on a D1 Mini Pre restock yet. More Scrypt miners are on the way to the store, but I won't guess when. If you want Doge today, the H15 Dual you looked at mines Dogecoin and Bitcoin. Is Doge or LTC the main goal?
Searched the catalog · scrypt miner dogecoin litecoin

For Scrypt in about the Mini Pre's price range, the DOGE TRIO PACK is the closest match. It's three Hammer DC06 units for $760, about 990 MH/s on Doge and Litecoin at roughly 315 W total. If you'd rather start with one machine, the Hammer DC08 is $539 and does about 480 MH/s at 137 W.

What do you pay for power per kWh? Then I can work out what each one costs to run.
no thanks i want a VolcMiner D1 Mini Pre
